title: Fintech digital wallet
brief: A digital wallet app. Users sign up with phone number and complete KYC with ID documents, add money from their bank account, send money to contacts, pay merchants by scanning a QR code and view their transaction history and monthly statements. Merchants receive payments and request settlements to their bank. A compliance team reviews flagged transactions for fraud and enforces daily limits. Every transaction must be exactly-once, auditable and reconciled daily.

requirements.title: Phone Registration and KYC
requirements.description: Users must register with a phone number and complete KYC verification using ID documents.

requirements.title: Bank Account Top-up
requirements.description: Users can add funds to their wallet from a linked bank account.

requirements.title: Peer-to-Peer and Merchant Payments
requirements.description: Users can send money to contacts and pay merchants via QR code scanning.

requirements.title: Transaction History and Statements
requirements.description: Users can view transaction history and monthly statements.

requirements.title: Merchant Settlement
requirements.description: Merchants can receive payments and request settlements to their bank accounts.

requirements.title: Compliance and Fraud Monitoring
requirements.description: Compliance team can review flagged transactions and enforce daily transfer limits.

requirements.title: Low Latency QR Payments
requirements.description: QR code merchant payments must process within two seconds under peak load.

requirements.title: Exactly-Once and Auditable Transactions
requirements.description: Every transaction must guarantee exactly-once execution and be fully auditable.

requirements.title: High Availability for Ledger
requirements.description: The wallet ledger and payment services must maintain ninety-nine point nine percent availability.

stories.title: As a user, I want to register with my phone and submit ID documents so that I can open a wallet.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration screen, when the user inputs a valid phone number, then an OTP is sent via SMS.
Given the OTP is verified, when the user uploads ID documents, then KYC status changes to pending.

stories.title: As a user, I want to link my bank account and add money so that I can fund my digital wallet.
acceptance_criteria: Given the wallet dashboard, when the user adds a bank account, then verification micro-deposits are initiated.
Given a linked bank account, when the user requests a top-up, then funds are credited to the wallet.

stories.title: As a user, I want to send money to phone contacts so that I can split bills easily.
acceptance_criteria: Given the contacts list, when the user selects a contact and enters an amount, then the transfer screen opens.
Given the confirmation step, when the user authorizes payment, then funds transfer instantly.

stories.title: As a user, I want to scan merchant QR codes so that I can pay for goods seamlessly.
acceptance_criteria: Given the in-app camera, when a valid merchant QR code is scanned, then the payment prompt appears.
Given the payment prompt, when the user confirms, then the merchant receives the funds immediately.

stories.title: As a user, I want to view my transaction history and monthly statements so that I can track my spending.
acceptance_criteria: Given the activity screen, when the user opens transaction history, then a paginated list of past transfers appears.
Given the statements screen, when the user selects a month, then a downloadable PDF statement is generated.

stories.title: As a merchant, I want to request settlements so that funds go to my bank.
acceptance_criteria: Given the merchant portal, when the user clicks request settlement, then pending balances are calculated.
Given a valid balance, when the settlement is submitted, then a bank transfer job is queued.

stories.title: As a compliance officer, I want to review flagged transactions and limits so that fraud is prevented.
acceptance_criteria: Given the compliance dashboard, when suspicious transactions appear, the officer can freeze the transfer.
Given user profiles, when daily limits are exceeded, then subsequent transfers are automatically blocked.

stories.title: As a user, I want fast QR payments so that I do not wait at checkout counters.
acceptance_criteria: Given network connectivity, when a QR payment is initiated, then the response returns in under two seconds.
Given high concurrency, when multiple users pay simultaneously, then latency remains within acceptable limits.

stories.title: As an auditor, I want exactly-once transaction processing so that ledger discrepancies never occur.
acceptance_criteria: Given a network retry during payment, when the request is sent twice, then the ledger debits only once.
Given any financial operation, when completed, then an immutable audit log record is written.

stories.title: As a platform operator, I want high availability so that users can pay anytime without downtime.
acceptance_criteria: Given system monitoring, when a primary database fails, then automatic failover occurs within thirty seconds.
Given scheduled maintenance, when updates occur, then zero-downtime deployment strategies are utilized.

risks.title: Double Spending via Network Retries
risks.description: Unsafe idempotency handling could allow users to double spend funds during network partitions.
risks.mitigation: Enforce strict idempotency keys and database constraints on all ledger movement transactions.

risks.title: KYC Document Fraud
risks.description: Fraudsters might use forged ID documents during sign-up to bypass AML controls.
risks.mitigation: Integrate third-party biometric verification and automated OCR checks for all ID uploads.

risks.title: Payment Gateway Latency Spikes
risks.description: External bank APIs could slow down, causing QR payments to exceed the performance threshold.
risks.mitigation: Implement asynchronous settlement queues and cache merchant metadata to minimize blocking calls.

modules.name: Auth and KYC Module
modules.responsibility: Handles phone registration, user profiles, and identity document verification.

modules.name: Ledger and Banking Module
modules.responsibility: Manages bank account linking, fund top-ups, balances, and exactly-once ledger entries.

modules.name: Payments and QR Module
modules.responsibility: Processes peer-to-peer transfers and low-latency merchant QR code payments.

modules.name: Reporting and Statement Module
modules.responsibility: Generates transaction histories and monthly statements for users.

modules.name: Merchant Settlement Module
modules.responsibility: Handles merchant onboarding, incoming payment reception, and bank settlement requests.

modules.name: Compliance and Fraud Module
modules.responsibility: Monitors daily limits, flags suspicious transactions, and supports compliance reviews.

entities.name: User
entities.description: Represents a registered wallet user including KYC status and phone number.

entities.name: BankAccount
entities.description: Linked external bank accounts used for top-ups and settlements.

entities.name: Wallet
entities.description: Stores user balances and currency information.

entities.name: Merchant
entities.description: Represents a registered merchant entity accepting payments via QR codes.

entities.name: Transaction
entities.description: Auditable record of every top-up, P2P transfer, or merchant payment.

entities.name: Settlement
entities.description: Records merchant payout requests to their linked bank accounts.

entities.name: ComplianceFlag
entities.description: Tracks flagged transactions under review by the compliance team.

apis.summary: Register a new user with phone number
Get user profile and KYC details
Update user KYC status and details
Add money to wallet from linked bank account
Send money to contacts or pay merchant via QR
Resolve or update a compliance review flag

tests.title: User registration and KYC submission
steps: Send POST /users with a valid phone number
Verify OTP verification succeeds
Update KYC status using PUT /users/{id}

tests.title: Bank account linking and wallet top-up
steps: Link bank account via POST /bank-accounts
Initiate top-up via POST /wallets/top-up
Confirm wallet balance is updated

tests.title: Peer-to-peer money transfer
steps: Initiate transfer to contact via POST /transfers
Verify transfer status is completed
Fetch transaction history via GET /transactions

tests.title: Merchant QR code payment processing
steps: Scan merchant QR payload and submit payment via POST /transfers
Measure response time to ensure it is under two seconds
Verify merchant account receives funds immediately

tests.title: Transaction history and monthly statements
steps: Retrieve paginated history using GET /transactions
Request monthly statement generation using GET /statements
Verify PDF statement output is returned successfully

tests.title: Merchant bank settlement request
steps: Calculate pending balance and submit settlement via POST /settlements
Poll settlement status via GET /settlements/{id}
Confirm bank transfer job is queued

tests.title: Compliance review and fraud flag resolution
steps: List flagged transactions using GET /compliance-flags
Attempt to resolve or freeze transfer via PATCH /compliance-flags/{id}
Verify unauthorized review attempts are blocked

tests.title: Idempotent exact-once ledger processing
steps: Submit a payment transfer request twice with the same idempotency key
Assert that the ledger debits the account only once
Verify immutable audit log records are written

tests.title: High availability and failover resilience
steps: Simulate primary database failure during peak transaction load
Verify automatic failover triggers within thirty seconds
Confirm zero dropped requests during zero-downtime deployment
